template: Scan the structure cube by cube, taking as vertical the direction the drawing renders as up: count exactly how many cubes have a visible top face, then work out exactly how many cubes are completely hidden from this viewpoint (tolerance 0 for both counts). State your conclusion, justify it by describing how you separated visible top faces from side faces and how the visible stacks imply any concealed cubes, and end with a confidence score from 0 to 1.

independent_derivation.method: separate formulas and geometry traversals; generator answer derivation is not called

deterministic_subfact_dependency_check.method: For every target sub-fact, test every 1-to-3-field subset of the other populated sub-facts. A relation is flagged when every repeated predictor tuple maps to one target and repeated tuples cover at least 80% of eligible rows. Explicit prohibited semantic identities remain validation failures.

visible_top_face_count.visual_signal: distinct rendered top-face rhombi with top-fill colour and boundary outline
visible_top_face_count.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery

hidden_cube_count.visual_signal: the visible column/occlusion geometry implied by the rendered top and side faces
hidden_cube_count.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery

human_vs_stored_20.review_method: manual count of rendered top-face rhombi and visual column/occlusion inference
